translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
aey kapray mein lipatney walay !
utho aur logon  ko khabrdar kero
aur apney perwerdigar ki takbeer kaho ,
aur apney kapron ko pak rakho ,
aur gandagi say kinara kerlo ,
aur koi ehsan iss niyyat say naa kero kay ziyada wasool ker-sako .
aur apney perwerdigar ki khatir sabar say kaam lo .
phir jab soor mein phoonk maar di jaye gi ,
to woh bara mushkil din hoga ,
kafiron kay liye woh aasaan nahi hoga .
uss shaks ka moamla mujh per chorr do jissay mein ney akela peda kiya ,
aur uss ko maal diya jo door tak phela parra hai ,
aur betay diye jo samney mojood rehtay hain ,
aur uss kay liye her kaam kay raastay humwaar kerdiye ,
phir bhi woh yeh lalach kerta hai kay mein ussay aur ziyada dun .
hergiz nahi ! woh humari aayaton ka dushman ban gaya hai ,
unqareeb mein ussay aik kathan charrhai per charhaon ga .
uss ka haal to yeh hai kay uss ney soch ker aik baat banai ,
khuda ki maar ho uss per kay kaisi baat banai !
dobara khuda ki maar ho uss per kay kaisi baat banai !
phir uss ney nazar dorrai ,
phir tewari charrhai , aur mun banaya ,
phir peechay ko murra , aur ghuroor dikhaya ,
phir kehney laga kay :  kuch nahi , yeh to aik riwayati jadoo hai ,
kuch nahi , yeh to aik insan ka kalam hai .
unqareeb mein uss shaks ko dozakh mein jhonk dun ga ,
aur tumhen kiya pata kay dozakh kiya cheez hai-?
woh naa kissi ko baqi rakhay gi , aur naa choray gi ,
woh khalon ko jhulas denay wali cheez hai ,
uss per unnees ( kaarinday ) muqarrar hon gay .

aur hum ney dozakh kay yeh kaarinday koi aur nahi , farishtay muqarrar kiye hain .   aur unn ki jo tadaad muqarrar ki hai , woh sirf iss liye kay uss kay zariye kafiron ki aazmaesh ho ,   takay ehal-e-kitab ko yaqeen aajaye ,   aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain , unn kay emaan mein aur izafa ho , aur ehal-e-kitab aur momin log kissi shak mein naa parren , aur takay woh log jinn kay dilon mein rog hai ,   aur jo log kafir hain , woh yeh kahen kay bhala iss ajeeb si baat say Allah ki kiya murad hai ? issi tarah Allah jiss ko chahta hai , gumrah ker deta hai , aur jiss ko chahta hai hidayat deta hai , aur tumharay perwerdigar kay lashkaron ko uss kay siwa koi nahi janta ,   aur yeh sari baat to noae bashar kay liye aik yaad dahani keraney wali naseehat hai , aur bus !
khabrdar ! qasam hai chaand ki ,
aur raat ki jab woh mun pher ker janey lagay ,
aur subha ki jab uss ka ujala phel jaye ,
kay yeh bari bari baaton mein say aik hai
jo tamam insanon ko khabrdar ker rahi hai ,
tum mein say her uss shaks ko jo aagay barhna ya peechay hatna chahye .
her shaks apney kartoot ki wajeh say girwi rakha huwa hai ,
siwaye dayen haath walon kay
kay woh jannaton mein hon gay . woh pooch rahey hon gay
mujrimon kay baaray mein ,
kay :  tumhen kiss cheez ney dozakh mein dakhil kerdiya ?
woh kahen gay kay :  hum namaz parhney walon mein say nahi thay ,
aur hum miskeen ko khana nahi khilatay thay ,
aur jo log beyhooda baaton mein ghustay , hum bhi unn kay sath ghuss jaya kertay thay ,
aur hum roz-e-jaza ko jhoot qarar detay thay ,
yahan tak kay woh yaqeeni baat humaray paas aa-hi gaee .
chunacheh sifarish kernay walon ki sifarish aesay logon  kay kaam nahi aaye gi .
abb inn logon  ko kiya hogaya hai kay yeh naseehat ki baat say mun morray huye hain-?
iss tarah jaisay woh jangli gadhay hon
jo kissi sher say ( darr ker ) bhag parray hon .
balkay inn mein say her shaks yeh chahta hai kay ussay khulay huye saheefay pakra diye jayen .
hergiz nahi !   baat asal mein yeh hai kay inn ko aakhirat ka khof nahi hai .
hergiz nahi ! yeh ( Quran hi ) aik naseehat hai ,
abb jo chahye , iss say naseehat hasil kerlay .
aur yeh log naseehat hasil keren gay nahi , illa yeh kay Allah hi aisa chahye . wohi iss baat ka ehal hai kay uss say dara jaye , aur wohi iss ka ehal hai kay logon  ki maghfirat keray .
